gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-kannada: Stencil-cut grace, packed close: that's Bevellier. Anek Kannada takes over below with a tall, squared-off lowercase and terminals held far from the stem, so paragraphs of it read like crisp woodblock type.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-vai: Cut-ribbon strokes, squat and wide: that's Bevellier. Where Bevellier excels at flat, constant-width display strokes, Noto Sans Vai excels at solid, modern word blocks with generous space around its curves.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-radio-canada: Graceful, stencil-cut, and tightly spaced, Bevellier leads. Radio Canada follows with tall, full lowercase c, s and z and a clear opening at every curve end, so paragraph after paragraph moves along smoothly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Noto Sans Old Italic brings a tight, contemporary sans partner to Expose. Both keep lowercase and capitals almost level in height, a shared trait that holds the pair together.
